cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I spent six months learning birds. That's preparation with feathers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.

mechanism: A makes its former quiz pupil credit preparation rather than favorable subject selection, correcting the pupil account of why A deserved the trophy.
confusable: Not merely celebrating winning: A specifically seeks an earned-result description against repeated luck explanations.
comparison: Prepared specialist knowledge versus avoiding a race equipment failure.
